text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Dober is frantically trying to pull herself out of her rut, Air Groove happens by and asks to talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During her conversation with Air Groove, Mejiro Dober admits she's afraid of breaking her promise to Mejiro Bright and of betraying people's expectations of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Air Groove points out that those fears are really a reflection of her progress. After all, those expectant fans wouldn't be there if she wasn't working so hard to keep her promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While her fears and tremors still linger after that talk, Mejiro Dober decides to run in the Japanese Oaks for all the people that support her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she declares her plan, I can see a bright light shining in her eyes, and that makes me confident that Mejiro Dober will get through this.
